meta.title: Pinions of Dawn
meta.description: Fire an arrow of daybreak that shatters the darkness.

units.rawText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.
units.displayText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.

spans.text: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.

units.rawText: Her vigor restored, Angelus shields the two behind herself, her eyes burning with fervid spirit.
units.displayText: Her vigor restored, Angelus shields the two behind herself, her eyes burning with fervid spirit.

spans.text: Her vigor restored, Angelus shields the two behind herself, her eyes burning with fervid spirit.

units.rawText: Good work, Professor!
units.displayText: Good work, Professor!

spans.text: Good work, Professor!

units.rawText: Whew... We really must thank them for their effects, dragging Angelus out of her disorientation.
units.displayText: Whew... We really must thank them for their effects, dragging Angelus out of her disorientation.

spans.text: Whew... We really must thank them for their effects, dragging Angelus out of her disorientation.

units.rawText: Though I never imagined that the remote link would work. Perhaps Angelus' faith played a part in it.
units.displayText: Though I never imagined that the remote link would work. Perhaps Angelus' faith played a part in it.

spans.text: Though I never imagined that the remote link would work. Perhaps Angelus' faith played a part in it.

units.rawText: What of the Sacred Canon, Antonina?
units.displayText: What of the Sacred Canon, Antonina?

spans.text: What of the Sacred Canon, Antonina?

units.rawText: I've located its other parts! Eosphorus has set up a firewall and it won't be a simple matter to get past it.
units.displayText: I've located its other parts! Eosphorus has set up a firewall and it won't be a simple matter to get past it.

spans.text: I've located its other parts! Eosphorus has set up a firewall and it won't be a simple matter to get past it.

units.rawText: Judging by its Entropization rate... There's basically no chance of removing his control on it quickly.
units.displayText: Judging by its Entropization rate... There's basically no chance of removing his control on it quickly.

spans.text: Judging by its Entropization rate... There's basically no chance of removing his control on it quickly.

units.rawText: ...I will believe in success.
units.displayText: ...I will believe in success.

spans.text: ...I will believe in success.

units.rawText: The Professor turns towards the now purple-shaded Sanctifier ranks. In front of them, Hesperus' flames burn brightly.
units.displayText: The Professor turns towards the now purple-shaded Sanctifier ranks. In front of them, Hesperus' flames burn brightly.

spans.text: The Professor turns towards the now purple-shaded Sanctifier ranks. In front of them, Hesperus' flames burn brightly.

units.rawText: Because we are not the only ones fighting against fate.
units.displayText: Because we are not the only ones fighting against fate.

spans.text: Because we are not the only ones fighting against fate.

units.rawText: ...Hey, hey, you can't possibly be thinking that everything is now going your way just because Big Sis Angelus is awake now, right?
units.displayText: ...Hey, hey, you can't possibly be thinking that everything is now going your way just because Big Sis Angelus is awake now, right?

spans.text: ...Hey, hey, you can't possibly be thinking that everything is now going your way just because Big Sis Angelus is awake now, right?

units.rawText: The fallen Greater Sanctifier smiles twistedly.
units.displayText: The fallen Greater Sanctifier smiles twistedly.

spans.text: The fallen Greater Sanctifier smiles twistedly.

units.rawText: Twas a shame I wasn't able to taste her despair... But I shall now destroy you in one fell swoop!
units.displayText: Twas a shame I wasn't able to taste her despair... But I shall now destroy you in one fell swoop!

spans.text: Twas a shame I wasn't able to taste her despair... But I shall now destroy you in one fell swoop!

units.rawText: Then, I shall make you all feast upon the deepest sorrow!
units.displayText: Then, I shall make you all feast upon the deepest sorrow!

spans.text: Then, I shall make you all feast upon the deepest sorrow!

units.rawText: Angelus does not waver in the face of Eucharist's taunts, only raising her bow once more.
units.displayText: Angelus does not waver in the face of Eucharist's taunts, only raising her bow once more.

spans.text: Angelus does not waver in the face of Eucharist's taunts, only raising her bow once more.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: With the divine Sanctifier oaths in the air, the Greater Sanctifier's figure is akin to a statue guiding the way.
units.displayText: With the divine Sanctifier oaths in the air, the Greater Sanctifier's figure is akin to a statue guiding the way.

spans.text: With the divine Sanctifier oaths in the air, the Greater Sanctifier's figure is akin to a statue guiding the way.

units.rawText: She stands and fully draws her bow. A speeding arrow rushes past Eucharist's face towards the outside of the Tower, exploding above the battlefield at the frontline.
units.displayText: She stands and fully draws her bow. A speeding arrow rushes past Eucharist's face towards the outside of the Tower, exploding above the battlefield at the frontline.

spans.text: She stands and fully draws her bow. A speeding arrow rushes past Eucharist's face towards the outside of the Tower, exploding above the battlefield at the frontline.

units.rawText: This is a signal of peace and safety set before the battle and a most powerful proof of her firm beliefs.
units.displayText: This is a signal of peace and safety set before the battle and a most powerful proof of her firm beliefs.

spans.text: This is a signal of peace and safety set before the battle and a most powerful proof of her firm beliefs.

units.rawText: Angelus, she... still fights for the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Angelus, she... still fights for the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Angelus, she... still fights for the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: I will leave the Professor with you, Angelus.
units.displayText: I will leave the Professor with you, Angelus.

spans.text: I will leave the Professor with you, Angelus.

units.rawText: She has not forgotten the Sanctifiers' glory. What of you, then?
units.displayText: She has not forgotten the Sanctifiers' glory. What of you, then?

spans.text: She has not forgotten the Sanctifiers' glory. What of you, then?

units.rawText: A flame rises from Hesperus' palm, gradually surrounding his vicinity.
units.displayText: A flame rises from Hesperus' palm, gradually surrounding his vicinity.

spans.text: A flame rises from Hesperus' palm, gradually surrounding his vicinity.

units.rawText: Unlike before, it is no longer violent and vicious. The coalesced operands are akin to a candle, igniting the battlefield painted black with despair.
units.displayText: Unlike before, it is no longer violent and vicious. The coalesced operands are akin to a candle, igniting the battlefield painted black with despair.

spans.text: Unlike before, it is no longer violent and vicious. The coalesced operands are akin to a candle, igniting the battlefield painted black with despair.

units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.displayText: The great blade slams into the ground, attracting the gaze of every Sanctifier present.

This is the Sanctifiers' glory and the oath that we have upheld our entire lives.
units.displayText: This is the Sanctifiers' glory and the oath that we have upheld our entire lives.

spans.text: This is the Sanctifiers' glory and the oath that we have upheld our entire lives.

units.rawText: ...It's futile. Their neural clouds are already under the Sacred Canon's control.
units.displayText: ...It's futile. Their neural clouds are already under the Sacred Canon's control.

spans.text: ...It's futile. Their neural clouds are already under the Sacred Canon's control.

units.displayText: All of it is futile. You merely waste what operands you have.

spans.text: All of it is futile. You merely waste what operands you have.

units.displayText: CLANG—

units.rawText: Another great strike of the blade is his response.
units.displayText: Another great strike of the blade is his response.

spans.text: Another great strike of the blade is his response.

units.rawText: I believe in you, in the possibility of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I believe in you, in the possibility of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I believe in you, in the possibility of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: So show me once more, the glory that was yours and only yours that day.
units.displayText: So show me once more, the glory that was yours and only yours that day.

spans.text: So show me once more, the glory that was yours and only yours that day.

units.rawText: The long night is silent, with only a lone candle swaying in the darkness.
units.displayText: The long night is silent, with only a lone candle swaying in the darkness.

spans.text: The long night is silent, with only a lone candle swaying in the darkness.

units.rawText: Then, a voice appears.
units.displayText: Then, a voice appears.

spans.text: Then, a voice appears.

units.rawText: We... we hone our blades...
units.displayText: We... we hone our blades...

spans.text: We... we hone our blades...

units.rawText: Pained as her expression may be, she speaks the oath engraved in her heart as her consciousness struggles.
units.displayText: Pained as her expression may be, she speaks the oath engraved in her heart as her consciousness struggles.

spans.text: Pained as her expression may be, she speaks the oath engraved in her heart as her consciousness struggles.

units.rawText: ...Good.
units.displayText: ...Good.

spans.text: ...Good.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader nods lightly. Shards of candlelight depart from Hesperus' palm, blossoming upon the Sanctifiers' bodies.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader nods lightly. Shards of candlelight depart from Hesperus' palm, blossoming upon the Sanctifiers' bodies.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader nods lightly. Shards of candlelight depart from Hesperus' palm, blossoming upon the Sanctifiers' bodies.

units.rawText: ...Impossible. The Sacred Canon should be in full control of them.
units.displayText: ...Impossible. The Sacred Canon should be in full control of them.

spans.text: ...Impossible. The Sacred Canon should be in full control of them.

units.rawText: Before Eosphorus can think on it further, more and more voices join the recitation of their oaths.
units.displayText: Before Eosphorus can think on it further, more and more voices join the recitation of their oaths.

spans.text: Before Eosphorus can think on it further, more and more voices join the recitation of their oaths.

units.rawText: In the darkness... we defend order in the face of chaos...
units.displayText: In the darkness... we defend order in the face of chaos...

spans.text: In the darkness... we defend order in the face of chaos...

units.rawText: We bear a light... in the long night...
units.displayText: We bear a light... in the long night...

spans.text: We bear a light... in the long night...

units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God...

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God...

units.rawText: <size=40>And we act to carry out His will!</size>
units.displayText: And we act to carry out His will!

spans.text: And we act to carry out His will!

units.rawText: Yes, now is the time to enact our oaths.
units.displayText: Yes, now is the time to enact our oaths.

spans.text: Yes, now is the time to enact our oaths.

units.rawText: The bright-yellow candlelight spreads amidst them, proliferating across the battlefield like a relayed torch.
units.displayText: The bright-yellow candlelight spreads amidst them, proliferating across the battlefield like a relayed torch.

spans.text: The bright-yellow candlelight spreads amidst them, proliferating across the battlefield like a relayed torch.

units.rawText: The light of stars gathers, igniting the Sanctifiers' eyes while driving away the darkness.
units.displayText: The light of stars gathers, igniting the Sanctifiers' eyes while driving away the darkness.

spans.text: The light of stars gathers, igniting the Sanctifiers' eyes while driving away the darkness.

units.rawText: <size=40>Lord Hesperus!</size>
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus!

spans.text: Lord Hesperus!

units.rawText: Finally come to your senses?
units.displayText: Finally come to your senses?

spans.text: Finally come to your senses?

units.rawText: Hesperus points the great blade in his hand at Eosphorus. This time, he would not be alone in challenging the stars.
units.displayText: Hesperus points the great blade in his hand at Eosphorus. This time, he would not be alone in challenging the stars.

spans.text: Hesperus points the great blade in his hand at Eosphorus. This time, he would not be alone in challenging the stars.

units.rawText: Looks like I won my gamble.
units.displayText: Looks like I won my gamble.

spans.text: Looks like I won my gamble.

units.rawText: ...The battle has only begun.
units.displayText: ...The battle has only begun.

spans.text: ...The battle has only begun.

units.rawText: With a wave of Eosphorus' hand, the earth beneath the battlefield begins to tremble once more.
units.displayText: With a wave of Eosphorus' hand, the earth beneath the battlefield begins to tremble once more.

spans.text: With a wave of Eosphorus' hand, the earth beneath the battlefield begins to tremble once more.

units.rawText: The broken ground is submerged by bright-red operands. Hordes of Entropics appear from behind the white steles, surrounding the many Sanctifiers, intending to devour what remains of their flame...
units.displayText: The broken ground is submerged by bright-red operands. Hordes of Entropics appear from behind the white steles, surrounding the many Sanctifiers, intending to devour what remains of their flame...

spans.text: The broken ground is submerged by bright-red operands. Hordes of Entropics appear from behind the white steles, surrounding the many Sanctifiers, intending to devour what remains of their flame...

units.rawText: ...That irritating expression again.
units.displayText: ...That irritating expression again.

spans.text: ...That irritating expression again.

units.rawText: <color=red>Why why why why why why WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY?</color>
units.displayText: Why why why why why why WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY?

spans.text: Why why why why why why WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY?

units.rawText: <color=red>Why must I be the one you look at that way?</color>
units.displayText: Why must I be the one you look at that way?

spans.text: Why must I be the one you look at that way?

units.rawText: Operands surge around Eucharist. Her face twists as the fork in her hand plunges into the ground over and over again, empowered by her angered questioning.
units.displayText: Operands surge around Eucharist. Her face twists as the fork in her hand plunges into the ground over and over again, empowered by her angered questioning.

spans.text: Operands surge around Eucharist. Her face twists as the fork in her hand plunges into the ground over and over again, empowered by her angered questioning.

units.rawText: What a joke! You want to say that you're the just one here?
units.displayText: What a joke! You want to say that you're the just one here?

spans.text: What a joke! You want to say that you're the just one here?

units.rawText: No, I just made my choice, one different from yours.
units.displayText: No, I just made my choice, one different from yours.

spans.text: No, I just made my choice, one different from yours.

units.rawText: Eucharist's anger spirals out of control at the word "choice".
units.displayText: Eucharist's anger spirals out of control at the word "choice".

spans.text: Eucharist's anger spirals out of control at the word "choice".

units.rawText: There was never a choice! You and I were nothing more than pawns! One of Eosphorus' experiments!
units.displayText: There was never a choice! You and I were nothing more than pawns! One of Eosphorus' experiments!

spans.text: There was never a choice! You and I were nothing more than pawns! One of Eosphorus' experiments!

units.rawText: We are Entropics, disguised as Sanctifiers! We never had the chance to make a choice!
units.displayText: We are Entropics, disguised as Sanctifiers! We never had the chance to make a choice!

spans.text: We are Entropics, disguised as Sanctifiers! We never had the chance to make a choice!

units.rawText: Even if you chose to join the Sanctifiers, they would purge you, the alien that you are!
units.displayText: Even if you chose to join the Sanctifiers, they would purge you, the alien that you are!

spans.text: Even if you chose to join the Sanctifiers, they would purge you, the alien that you are!

units.rawText: Remember this! I am your only kin in this world who will love you! The only one who will accept you!
units.displayText: Remember this! I am your only kin in this world who will love you! The only one who will accept you!

spans.text: Remember this! I am your only kin in this world who will love you! The only one who will accept you!

units.rawText: So hurry up! Hurry up with killing those two behind you and come to my side!
units.displayText: So hurry up! Hurry up with killing those two behind you and come to my side!

spans.text: So hurry up! Hurry up with killing those two behind you and come to my side!

units.rawText: Angelus lowers the bow in her hand, slowly shaking her head.
units.displayText: Angelus lowers the bow in her hand, slowly shaking her head.

spans.text: Angelus lowers the bow in her hand, slowly shaking her head.

units.rawText: You are wrong, Eucharist.
units.displayText: You are wrong, Eucharist.

spans.text: You are wrong, Eucharist.

units.rawText: My origin has never defined who I am.
units.displayText: My origin has never defined who I am.

spans.text: My origin has never defined who I am.

units.rawText: The flowers she accepted from Agents bloom in her heart still.
units.displayText: The flowers she accepted from Agents bloom in her heart still.

spans.text: The flowers she accepted from Agents bloom in her heart still.

units.rawText: I do not protect them because I am a Sanctifier...
units.displayText: I do not protect them because I am a Sanctifier...

spans.text: I do not protect them because I am a Sanctifier...

units.rawText: The oath sworn beneath the steles has never gone forgotten, it still radiates in times of struggle.
units.displayText: The oath sworn beneath the steles has never gone forgotten, it still radiates in times of struggle.

spans.text: The oath sworn beneath the steles has never gone forgotten, it still radiates in times of struggle.

units.rawText: I chose to become a Sanctifier because I wanted to protect them.
units.displayText: I chose to become a Sanctifier because I wanted to protect them.

spans.text: I chose to become a Sanctifier because I wanted to protect them.

units.rawText: She holds fast to her weapon once again.
units.displayText: She holds fast to her weapon once again.

spans.text: She holds fast to her weapon once again.

units.rawText: I shall enact the Sanctifier oath and fight for the peace of Magrasea.
units.displayText: I shall enact the Sanctifier oath and fight for the peace of Magrasea.

spans.text: I shall enact the Sanctifier oath and fight for the peace of Magrasea.

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.rawText: What the hell are these utterly boring platitudes?
units.displayText: What the hell are these utterly boring platitudes?

spans.text: What the hell are these utterly boring platitudes?

units.rawText: Do you really believe any of this? You'll go and fight, for these nonexistent things?
units.displayText: Do you really believe any of this? You'll go and fight, for these nonexistent things?

spans.text: Do you really believe any of this? You'll go and fight, for these nonexistent things?

units.rawText: Yes, I will.
units.displayText: Yes, I will.

spans.text: Yes, I will.

units.rawText: Even if I will never see the dawn of victory.
units.displayText: Even if I will never see the dawn of victory.

spans.text: Even if I will never see the dawn of victory.

units.rawText: Boring.
units.displayText: Boring.

spans.text: Boring.

units.rawText: A malevolent shade of black begins to seep out of her body, a signature of Entropic power. It leaks into the surrounding space, darkening the very surroundings.
units.displayText: A malevolent shade of black begins to seep out of her body, a signature of Entropic power. It leaks into the surrounding space, darkening the very surroundings.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>Boring boring boring boring BORING BORING BORING BORING BORING BORING!</color></size>

spans.text: Boring boring boring boring BORING BORING BORING BORING BORING BORING!

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>So... truly boring!</color></size>
units.displayText: So... truly boring!

spans.text: So... truly boring!

units.rawText: When the vortex of energies ceases, the darkness' ruler emerges from within.
units.displayText: When the vortex of energies ceases, the darkness' ruler emerges from within.

spans.text: When the vortex of energies ceases, the darkness' ruler emerges from within.

units.rawText: That appearance of yours...
units.displayText: That appearance of yours...

spans.text: That appearance of yours...

units.rawText: <color=purple>...This is how we should be, Big Sis.</color>
units.displayText: ...This is how we should be, Big Sis.

spans.text: ...This is how we should be, Big Sis.

units.rawText: <color=purple>I already tire of your theories. When you get down to it, your ideals are of no worth in this battle.</color>
units.displayText: I already tire of your theories. When you get down to it, your ideals are of no worth in this battle.

spans.text: I already tire of your theories. When you get down to it, your ideals are of no worth in this battle.

units.rawText: Her now baleful presence fills the room.
units.displayText: Her now baleful presence fills the room.

spans.text: Her now baleful presence fills the room.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Only the victor's ideals can be correct, Big Sis. Regrettably, you are no match for me now.</color>
units.displayText: Only the victor's ideals can be correct, Big Sis. Regrettably, you are no match for me now.

spans.text: Only the victor's ideals can be correct, Big Sis. Regrettably, you are no match for me now.

units.rawText: ...Won't know until we try.
units.displayText: ...Won't know until we try.

spans.text: ...Won't know until we try.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier manifests her bow and arrow, holding it in her hand.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier manifests her bow and arrow, holding it in her hand.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier manifests her bow and arrow, holding it in her hand.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Then struggle, drown in your ideals and die.</color>
units.displayText: Then struggle, drown in your ideals and die.

spans.text: Then struggle, drown in your ideals and die.

units.rawText: <color=purple><size=40>Come, Big Sis! Have this last dance with me!</size></color>
units.displayText: Come, Big Sis! Have this last dance with me!

spans.text: Come, Big Sis! Have this last dance with me!
